long_biography.plain_text:
Stéphane Uzan has led Foncière Saint Honoré since the mid-2000s, first as manager and later as president. Working through a network of project companies, he has pursued residential development, property trading, leasing and asset management across Paris and the surrounding region. The group has also bought and sold sizeable office properties, development sites and land.

His business structure extends beyond conventional development into hospitality and property-backed operating companies. Uzan serves as president or manager across dozens of entities, including Foncière des Tournelles and FSH Hospitality, while Foncière Saint Honoré owns or represents multiple single-asset ventures. This pattern reflects a hands-on property operator who uses dedicated companies to acquire, develop, hold and reposition individual assets.
